Immediately after the contract is awarded, contractor shall visit the user with all the documents for verif ication. This shall be done within 3 days from the date of award of contract. 9. Any deficiency in the above services will attract a penalty as per GeM contract. 10. A red board with "On duty, Government of India" to be put in the front of the vehicle. 11.
